# QA Report — Stick-Figure Samurai Rig Check

## Image 1 (idle)
- **ARMS:** One arm clearly inverted — the front arm bends with the elbow pointing backward/down and forearm folding forward, opposite the rear arm's bend. They do NOT mirror anatomically. Attachment point is ambiguous — arms appear to originate near the upper torso/neck cluster rather than distinct shoulders. The free-swinging rear arm (with the ring/tail element) hangs low, detaching visually from the shoulder line.
- **POSTURE:** Torso lean looks close to ~5°, acceptable. Height is OK — not collapsed.
- **LEGS:** Legs are largely obscured under the sword sheath/glow; can't confirm knee direction. Feet appear to touch ground.
- **SHADOW:** Shadow sits under the character, roughly centered. OK.
- **VERDICT: FAIL** — inverted elbow on one arm + questionable shoulder attachment; legs unverifyable due to weapon occlusion.

## Image 2 (sword-drawn guard)
- **ARMS:** Front (sword) arm bends correctly toward the body. Rear arm is hard to read but appears to fold the wrong way — elbow forward with forearm sweeping back behind the torso. Attachment looks closer to the neck/chin area than the shoulders; the head overlaps the arm origin.
- **POSTURE:** Slight forward lean, reasonable for a guard stance. Standing height fine.
- **LEGS:** Stance is compressed; front knee bend reads correct, rear leg is hidden behind the sheath. One foot clearly grounded.
- **SHADOW:** Centered under feet. OK.
- **VERDICT: FAIL (marginal)** — rear arm elbow inverted and shoulder anchor sits too high/neck-adjacent.

## Image 3 (running)
- **ARMS:** The sword arm is fixed mid-swing and reads correctly; the rear arm trails behind with a plausible bend. No obvious inversion. Attachment near shoulder line, though slightly high.
- **POSTURE:** Forward lean present, roughly in the 10–15° range — good for a run. Full standing height.
- **LEGS:** Running pose visible; knee of the trailing leg bends backward correctly, front leg partially occluded by the sword. At least one foot in contact/approaching ground.
- **SHADOW:** Centered beneath the character. OK.
- **VERDICT: PASS** — best frame of the set; pose and rig read correctly.

## Image 4 (stopped)
- **ARMS:** Both arms bend in consistent, anatomically-correct directions; rear arm settles naturally behind. Attached at shoulder height.
- **POSTURE:** Upright with slight forward lean (~5–10°), appropriate for a stopping/deceleration frame. Height normal.
- **LEGS:** Knees bend backward correctly on the visible front leg; one foot grounded.
- **SHADOW:** Directly under feet, correct.
- **VERDICT: PASS** — clean settle pose, no rig defects visible.

## Summary
| Image | Verdict | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| 1 idle | FAIL | Inverted elbow, arms anchored near neck, legs occluded |
| 2 guard | FAIL | Rear arm elbow inverted, high shoulder anchor |
| 3 running | PASS | Correct lean, knees, shadow |
| 4 stopped | PASS | All checks pass |

**Recommendation:** Fix the IK/elbow-solve direction for the off-hand arm and lower the arm anchor from neck to shoulder joints — the defect appears consistently on frames 1–2.
